definitions.explanation: A decorative pattern featuring flowers or floral motifs, commonly found on fabric, clothing, tableware, and other surfaces.

examples.japanese: {花柄|はながら}のワンピースを{着|き}た。
{母|はは}は{花柄|はながら}の{食器|しょっき}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: My mother likes tableware with floral patterns.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると、{花柄|はながら}の{服|ふく}を{着|き}ている{人|ひと}が{多|おお}くなる。
examples.english: When spring comes, you see more people wearing clothes with floral patterns.

notes:
A compound of {花|はな} (flower) and {柄|がら} (pattern; design on fabric). The {柄|がら} element is productive and appears in many pattern-describing compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花柄|はながら}のワンピース: floral-print dress
- {花柄|はながら}のカーテン: floral-print curtains
- {花柄|はながら}の{壁紙|かべがみ}: floral wallpaper
- {小|こ}{花柄|はながら}: small floral print
- {大|おお}{花柄|はながら}: large floral print

RELATED PATTERN WORDS:
- {縞模様|しまもよう}: striped pattern
- {水玉模様|みずたまもよう}: polka-dot pattern
- {格子模様|こうしもよう}: checkered pattern; plaid
- {無地|むじ}: solid color; plain (no pattern)
- {柄物|がらもの}: patterned item (as opposed to plain)
